checks.name: Decline Delete

checks.name: Confirm Delete leaves loaded values and Preview

limits: This is bounded owner-assisted native functional evidence on the recorded Windows 10 binary, not visual, scaling or clean target-desktop acceptance.

UIA does not expose checkbox ToggleState or internal Preview identity. Enabled input values, stored configuration and the forced/non-forced Preview semantics corroborate configuration; matching captions alone do not establish checked state.
The destination was empty and no individual approval existed. No claim is made about native preservation of a previously approved plan in this scenario; controlled/headless tests cover that behavior.
Preview was invoked once. Apply, plan approval, aggregate Review and Run were not invoked; no native remux/publication or cancellation evidence is claimed.
Observation timestamps are API/readback times, not physical input-event times.
Task-local files retain full captured states; public excerpts omit unchanged chrome, navigation and unrelated controls. Paths are task-relative; no binaries or large raw logs are committed.
infrastructureLimits: Native capture/coordinate geometry and system-picker input limitations were not retried; the owner completed only the documented tab/picker handoffs.
An expanded-combo Down route lost usable focus; the documented collapsed-combo keyboard route selected the entry successfully after fresh observation.

Some set_value calls reported wait for accessibility set value: timed out waiting on channel even though a later observation confirmed the intended value/focus. No blind retyping or activation followed a timeout.
Immediate post-key UIA focus sometimes lagged. Separate settled-focus observations preceded Space/type actions; no fixed Tab counts or alternative automation were used.

remainingLimits: No native visual/scaling claim or clean Windows 11/Ubuntu Desktop acceptance.
Historical Phase 2B3 accidental aggregate Review remains recorded in its original evidence.
Existing warning-fixture/cancellation and licensing/redistribution gaps remain open.
No preset overwrite/update, import/export, automatic loading/application, persistent queue or new media filter.
